newsitem.title: USA: SOS Staffing names vice chairwoman and CEO.
newsitem.headline: SOS Staffing names vice chairwoman and CEO.

text.p: SOS Staffing Services Inc said Monday it had named Howard Scott, formerly president and chief operating officer, as its chief executive officer and named JoAnn Wagner as vice chairwoman.
Scott takes on the CEO job from Richard Reinhold, who remains chairman of the board.
Wagner, who has been an outside director and consultant for SOS since July 1995, will focus primarily on pursuing and integrating acquisitions.
The company also named Peter Sollenne as president and chief operating officer, filling the vacancies left by Scott.
